Two forms you will see in older prompts. Neither works; do not copy them:

| Form | Why it fails |
|---|---|
| `gh pr comment` / `gh pr review` / `gh pr ready` | GraphQL. Returns 403 in a restricted session |
| `--body "$(cat <<EOF ... EOF)"` | The heredoc body is data the shell expands before `gh` sees it; multi-line content and backticks are unreliable in this position. Use the `Write`-then-`-F body=@path` pattern instead. |

### Reading runtime values in a shell block

The single supported mechanism for capturing a value at runtime is
`$(inner_cmd)` where `inner_cmd` is a command your agent's allowlist already
grants:

```bash
STARTED=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
SNAPSHOT_ID=$(gh api repos/$REPO/issues/$ISSUE_NUMBER/comments --jq '.[] | .id')
```

The scope enforcer extracts the inner command, checks it against the allowlist
independently, and refuses it only if the inner command is not granted. A
non-allowlisted inner command is denied the same way any other ungranteed
command is — the bypass hole that issue #362 closed remains closed.
